title: Configuration Service: Complete Architecture
description: Design a config service with versioned key-value storage, watch-based hot reload, and multi-layer caching.

data.text: Design a centralized configuration service so applications can read runtime configuration without redeploying, receive updates within seconds, and roll back safely.

terms.definition: Applications pick up config changes without restarting.
Every change creates an immutable version, enabling audit and rollback.
A long-poll or push mechanism so clients are notified of changes immediately.

data.title: Functional Requirements
items: Get/Set config by namespace and key
Watch for changes in real time

data.caption: Config Service: API, versioned store, change notification bus, and client-side watchers with caching
data.definition:
flowchart TD
    API[Config API]
    Store[(Versioned Config Store)]
    Bus[Change Notification Bus]
    Cache[Distributed Cache]
    Clients[Client Apps with Watchers]

    API --> Store
    Store --> Bus
    API --> Cache
    Bus --> Clients
    Clients --> Cache
    Clients --> API

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Immutable versions + rollback are essential for safety
Watch-based push is better than polling for latency
data.takeaway: A versioned store with a pub-sub change bus gives safe, fast dynamic configuration.
